pr_body:
This commit adds a new response field to the
SpanStats rpc, `StoreIDs` which is a list of
unique store ids in ascending order that store
the requested span.

Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/129060
Release note: None

issue_context.title: server: add unique store ids to SpanStats response
issue_context.body:
We should return unique store ids for requested spans in the SpanStats rpc.
This information will be stored in the new cached table metadata table so that db console can then map these store ids to locality and region info. Currently this information is retrieved using a seprate call to `SHOW RANGES FOR TABLE` which is expensive. We can piggyback onto the span stats rpc instead.

Jira issue: CRDB-41359

Epic CRDB-37558
